description:
What this is. Which day an employee rests comes from the holiday list they are on, so moving a rest day means moving them to a different list — tedious one person at a time.

What to do. Pick the group and the list they should be on, and submit. Each person gets a dated record of the move, so the change applies from the day you chose and their history stays intact.

Where to find it. Bulk Week Off in the menu on the left.
name: Move a Group's Day Off
title: Bulk Week Off — assign the holiday list
